selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 灵魂石和制造治疗石的施法时间缩短50%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reduces the cast time of Soulstone and Create Healthstone by 50%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你和你宠物的最大生命值提高5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases you and your pets' maximum health by 5%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 吸取生命的引导速度加快100%，恢复生命的速度加快100%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Drain Life now channels 100% faster and restores health 100% faster.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你为自己召唤的治疗石变为恶魔治疗石，可以在战斗中使用多次。恶魔治疗石无法交易。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Healthstones you conjure for yourself are now Demonic Healthstones and can be used multiple times in combat. Demonic Healthstones cannot be traded.

subSpellsCn.name: 恶魔治疗石
subSpellsCn.description: 立即恢复25%的生命值 [强化治疗石: ，并在6秒内额外恢复30%的生命值。 / 。]

subSpellsEn.name: Demonic Healthstone
subSpellsEn.description: Instantly restores 25% health [Empowered Healthstone: plus an additional 30% over 6 sec / .]

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 耐力提高10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Stamina increased by 10%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你下一次召唤小鬼、虚空行者、夜魔、魅魔、地狱猎犬或恶魔卫士不消耗能量，施法时间缩短90%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Incubus, Succubus, Felhunter, or Felguard Summon spell is free and has its casting time reduced by 90%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你和你的仆从造成的所有单体伤害会为你和你的宠物提供一个能够吸收伤害的暗影护盾，吸收量相当于造成伤害的3%，持续15秒，吸收量最多不超过最大生命值的5 / 恶魔皮肤: 10 / 邪蹄诡图: 20 / 强韧灵魂: 10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: All single-target damage done by you and your minions grants you and your pet shadowy shields that absorb 3% of the damage dealt for 15 sec, up to 5 / Demon Skin: 10 / Illhoof's Design: 20 / Fortified Soul: 10% of maximum health.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 牺牲你当前生命值的20%，为你施加护盾抵挡伤害。该护盾可吸收相当于已牺牲生命值的200%以及额外的(法术强度 * 2.5)点伤害，持续20秒。可在遭受控制限制效果时施放。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Sacrifices 20% of your current health to shield you for 200% of the sacrificed health plus an additional (Spell Power * 2.5) for 20 sec. Usable while suffering from control impairing effects.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 黑暗契约的冷却时间缩短15秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reduces the cooldown of Dark Pact by 15 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
暗影之怒的冷却时间缩短15秒，半径增加2码。

恐惧嚎叫的冷却时间缩短5秒，并且现在额外恐惧5个敌人。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Reduces the cooldown of Shadowfury by 15 sec and increases its radius by 2 yds.

Reduces the cooldown of Howl of Terror by 5 sec and it now fears 5 additional enemies.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使敌方目标因恐惧而逃跑，瘫痪3秒，并为你恢复20%的最大生命值。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Horrifies an enemy target into fleeing, incapacitating for 3 sec and healing you for 20% of maximum health.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使8码范围内的所有敌人昏迷，持续3秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Stuns all enemies within 8 yds for 3 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 爆燃冲刺造成的伤害降低10%。爆燃冲刺使你的移动速度额外提高20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reduces the damage dealt by Burning Rush by 10%. Burning Rush increases your movement speed by an additional 20%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使你的移动速度提高50%，但每1秒会对你造成4%最大生命值的伤害。期间移动限制效果不会让你的移动速度降低到正常移动速度的100%以下，持续直到主动取消。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases your movement speed by 50%, but also damages you for 4% of your maximum health every 1 sec. Movement impairing effects may not reduce you below 100% of normal movement speed. Lasts until canceled.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
灵魂榨取吸收伤害时，会将所受伤害的5%吸收并分散在5秒内。

受到的伤害降低1.5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
When Soul Leech absorbs damage, 5% of damage taken is absorbed and spread out over 5 sec.

Reduces damage taken by 1.5%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
你的灵魂榨取的吸收效果会被动恢复，每1秒恢复最大生命值的0.2%，并且现在会额外吸收生命值上限的5%。

你的护甲值提高45%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Your Soul Leech absorption now passively recharges at a rate of 0.2% of maximum health every 1 sec, and may now absorb an additional 5% of maximum health.

Increases your armor by 45%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 在两个位置分别召唤一个恶魔传送门。使用者激活传送门后会立即被传送到另一个传送门。每名玩家每90秒只能使用一次恶魔传送门。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Creates a demonic gateway between two locations. Activating the gateway transports the user to the other gateway. Each player can use a Demonic Gateway only once per 90 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 不灭决心会使你受到的伤害额外降低15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Unending Resolve reduces damage taken by an additional 15%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 消耗一块灵魂碎片，解锁你法术中的隐藏能力。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Consumes a Soul Shard, unlocking the hidden power of your spells.

subSpellsCn.name: 恶魔法阵：传送
subSpellsCn.description: ：使你的移动速度提高50%，并且使你免疫诱捕和定身效果，持续6秒。

subSpellsCn.name: 吸取生命
subSpellsCn.description: ：获得与治疗量等量的吸收盾，持续30秒。护盾的吸收总量不超过你最大生命值的30%。

subSpellsCn.name: 治疗石
subSpellsCn.description: ：使你的治疗石的治疗效果提高30%，使用治疗石还会使你的最大生命值提高20%，持续12秒。

subSpellsEn.name: Demonic Circle: Teleport
subSpellsEn.description: : Increases your movement speed by 50% and makes you immune to snares and roots for 6 sec.

subSpellsEn.name: Drain Life
subSpellsEn.description: : Gain an absorb shield equal to the amount of healing done for 30 sec. This shield cannot exceed 30% of your maximum health.

subSpellsEn.name: Healthstone
subSpellsEn.description: : Increases the healing of your Healthstone by 30% and increases your maximum health by 20% for 12 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
召唤一道持续15分钟的恶魔法阵。施放恶魔法阵：传送可将你传送到恶魔法阵的位置，并移除所有减速效果。 [基尔罗格的狡诈: 如果你在控制一个基尔罗格之眼时施放恶魔法阵：传送，法阵将出现在基尔罗格之眼的位置。]

你还学会了：
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Summons a Demonic Circle for 15 min. Cast Demonic Circle: Teleport to teleport to its location and remove all movement slowing effects. [Kilrogg's Cunning: If you cast Demonic Circle: Summon while controlling an Eye of Kilrogg, the circle will appear where the eye is located]

You also learn:

subSpellsCn.name: 恶魔法阵：传送
subSpellsCn.description: 将你传送到你的恶魔法阵并移除所有移动减速效果。

subSpellsEn.name: Demonic Circle: Teleport
subSpellsEn.description: Teleports you to your Demonic Circle and removes all movement slowing effects.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 施放疲劳诅咒、语言诅咒或虚弱诅咒现在会诅咒目标10码范围内的所有敌人。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Casting Curse of Exhaustion, Curse of Tongues, or Curse of Weakness now curses all enemies within 10 yds of the target.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
恶魔学识
你所受伤害的5%会由你的恶魔宠物替你承担。

 痛苦,  毁灭
你所受伤害的5%会由你的恶魔宠物替你承担。

当牺牲魔典激活时，你的耐力提高3%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Demonology
5% of all damage you take is taken by your demon pet instead. 

 Affliction,  Destruction
5% of all damage you take is taken by your demon pet instead. 

While Grimoire of Sacrifice is active, your Stamina is increased by 3%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使你的智力提高3%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases your Intellect by 3%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 死亡缠绕的射程增加10码，并且死亡缠绕现在会额外治疗5%的最大生命值。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases the range of Mortal Coil by 10 yds and Mortal Coil now heals for an additional 5% of maximum health.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
强迫目标使用恶魔语，使其所有法术的施放时间延长30%，持续1分钟。

诅咒：对于一个目标，每个术士只能施加一种诅咒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Forces the target to speak in Demonic, increasing the casting time of all spells by 30% for 1 min.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
使目标的移动速度降低50%，持续12秒。

诅咒：对于一个目标，每个术士只能施加一种诅咒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Reduces the target's movement speed by 50% for 12 sec.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使你的爆击几率提高2%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases your critical strike chance by 2%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使你的急速提高2%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases your haste by 2%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使你的吸血提高2%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases your Leech by 2%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 灵魂榨取现在可以额外吸收你生命值上限的5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Soul Leech may now absorb an additional 5% of your maximum health.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 治疗石为你恢复额外5%的生命值。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Healthstones heal you for an additional 5% additional health.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
召唤一团阴暗的暗影迷雾笼罩目标及其10码内的所有敌人，使其所有法术的施法时间延长100%，持续12秒。

诅咒：一名术士在每个目标身上只能同时激活一种诅咒或灾厄效果。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Call forth a cloud of cloying shadow mist that envelopes the target and all enemies within 10 yds, increasing their casting time of all spells by 100% for 12 sec.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse or Blight active per target.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
为你的黑眼装备源自安托鲁斯的战铠，使其护甲值提高10%。

眼棱现在会在10码范围内额外弹射至最多4个目标，并造成10%额外伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Adorns your Darkglare with armor forged from within Antorus, increasing their armor by 10%. 

Eye Beam now jumps to up to 4 additional targets within 10 yards and deals 10% increased damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
鬼魂纠缠一个目标，造成([720.612% of Spell Power])点暗影伤害，并使你对该目标造成的伤害提高16%，持续18秒。

如果目标死亡，重置鬼影缠身的冷却时间。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
A ghostly soul haunts a single target, dealing (720.612% of Spell Power) Shadow damage and increasing your damage dealt to the target by 16% for 18 sec.

If the target dies, Haunt's cooldown is reset.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 痛楚、腐蚀术、痛苦无常、腐蚀之种和 [吸取灵魂 / 暗影箭]对生命值低于35%的目标额外造成最多40%的伤害。对生命值越低的目标造成的伤害越高。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Agony, Corruption, Unstable Affliction, Seed of Corruption, and [Drain Soul / Shadow Bolt] deal up to 40% increased damage on targets below 35% health. Damage increase is higher against lower health targets.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
从扭曲虚空召唤一只黑眼，激活期间使你的痛楚，[腐蚀术]和痛苦无常的伤害提高20%。

黑眼会为你效命，持续20秒，冲击目标，造成([487.044% of Spell Power])点暗影伤害。你在其当前目标身上每有一个持续伤害效果激活，就会使此伤害提高10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Summons a Darkglare from the Twisting Nether that increases the damage of your Agony, Corruption, and Unstable Affliction by 20% while active.

The Darkglare will serve you for 20 sec, blasting its target for (487.044% of Spell Power) Shadow damage, increased by 10% for every damage over time effect you have active on their current target.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的法术和恶魔的伤害提高3%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases the damage dealt by your spells and your demon by 3%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 痛楚、腐蚀术和痛苦无常的爆击伤害提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases critical strike damage dealt by Agony, Corruption, and Unstable Affliction by 15%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 暗影箭的施法时间降低15%，伤害提升40%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reduces the cast time of Shadow Bolt by 15% and increases its damage by 40%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
腐蚀术的伤害有一定几率使你的下一次暗影箭或灾难之握造成25%的额外伤害。

受此影响时，暗影箭变为瞬发，灾难之握的引导速度提升50%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Corruption damage has a chance to cause your next Shadow Bolt or Malefic Grasp to deal 25% increased damage. 

Shadow Bolt is instant cast and Malefic Grasp channels 50% faster when affected.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 使目标受到越来越深的痛楚，在18秒内造成最多[([9.31297% of Spell Power]) * 18 / 2 * 8]点暗影伤害。该伤害在初期较低，但随着持续时间会不断提高。在目标身上刷新痛楚时会保持其当前的伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Inflicts increasing agony on the target, causing up to [(9.31297% of Spell Power) * 18 / 2 * 8] Shadow damage over 18 sec. Damage starts low and increases over the duration. Refreshing Agony maintains its current damage level.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
将恶魔之种嵌入敌人身体，12秒后爆炸，对10码范围内所有施法者的敌人造成([236.5% of Spell Power])点暗影伤害，并对其施放腐蚀术。超过8个目标后伤害降低。

如果目标被其他腐蚀之种的爆炸击中，或从你的法术中受到(暗影法术强度 * 50 / 100)点伤害，则会提前引爆。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Embeds a demon seed in the enemy target that will explode after 12 sec, dealing (236.5% of Spell Power) Shadow damage to all enemies within 10 yards and applying Corruption to them. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

The seed will detonate early if the target is hit by other detonations, or takes (Shadow spell power * 50 / 100) damage from your spells.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 暗影箭和吸取灵魂有一定几率触发暗影箭雨，对你当前目标10码范围内的5个敌人造成[([124.74% of Spell Power]) * 1 * 1]点暗影伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Shadow Bolt and Drain Soul have a chance to trigger a Shadow Bolt Volley, dealing [(124.74% of Spell Power) * 1 * 1] Shadow damage to 5 enemies within 10 yards of your current target.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的痛楚、腐蚀术和痛苦无常造成伤害的速度提高10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Your Agony, Corruption, and Unstable Affliction deal damage 10% faster.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
痛苦
你的恶魔之魂造成的伤害提高10%。

消耗夜幕会滋养你体内的恶魔实体，使其现身并对目标造成([601.005% of Spell Power])点暗影伤害。

 恶魔学识
你的恶魔之魂造成的伤害提高30%。

消耗恶魔之核会滋养你体内的恶魔实体，使其现身并对目标造成[([601.005% of Spell Power]) * 0.4]点暗影伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Affliction
Damage dealt by your demonic soul is increased by 10%.

Consuming Nightfall feeds the demonic entity within you, causing it to appear and deal (601.005% of Spell Power) Shadow damage to your target.

 Demonology
Damage dealt by your demonic soul is increased by 30%.

Consuming Demonic Core feeds the demonic entity within you, causing it to appear and deal [(601.005% of Spell Power) * 0.4] Shadow damage to your target.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 邪能统御的冷却时间缩短90秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Fel Domination cooldown is reduced by 90 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
痛苦
暗影箭和吸取灵魂的伤害提高20%。夜幕使暗影箭和吸取灵魂的伤害额外提高50%。

 恶魔学识
暗影箭的伤害提高20%。能量虹吸使恶魔之箭的伤害额外提高20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Affliction
Shadow Bolt and Drain Soul damage increased by 20%. Nightfall increases the damage of Shadow Bolt and Drain Soul by an additional 50%.

 Demonology
Shadow Bolt damage increased by 20%. Power Siphon increases the damage of Demonbolt by an additional 20%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
痛苦
你的恶魔之魂对受到你的痛苦无常影响的目标造成的伤害提高100%。

 恶魔学识
你的恶魔之魂对古尔丹之手的主要目标造成的伤害提高200%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Affliction
Your demonic soul deals 100% increased damage to targets affected by your Unstable Affliction.

 Demonology
Your demonic soul deals 200% increased damage to the main target of Hand of Gul'dan.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
痛苦
腐蚀术造成伤害的速度加快25%，鬼影缠身会触发夜幕。

 恶魔学识
野生小鬼的伤害提高35%，内爆的野生小鬼产生恶魔之核的几率提高5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Affliction
Corruption deals damage 25% faster and Haunt grants Nightfall.

 Demonology
Wild Imp damage increased by 35% and Wild Imps that are imploded have an additional 5% chance to grant a Demonic Core.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
痛苦
蚀魂之咒的伤害提高25%，造成伤害的速度加快20%。

消耗夜幕会激活命运相连或灵魂盛宴。

 恶魔学识
蚀魂之咒的伤害提高25%，造成伤害的速度加快20%。

消耗恶魔之核会激活命运相连或灵魂盛宴。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Demonology
Soul Anathema damage increased by 25% and is dealt 20% faster.

Consuming Demonic Core activates Shared Fate or Feast of Souls.

 Affliction
Soul Anathema damage increased by 25% and is dealt 20% faster.

Consuming Nightfall activates Shared Fate or Feast of Souls.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
释放你的恶魔之魂会让恶毒的实体侵蚀目标的灵魂，在10秒内造成([114.712% of Spell Power])点暗影伤害。

重复施加该效果时，剩余伤害会添加到新的蚀魂之咒中。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Unleashing your demonic soul bestows a fiendish entity unto the soul of its targets, dealing (114.712% of Spell Power) Shadow damage over 10 sec.

If this effect is reapplied, any remaining damage will be added to the new Soul Anathema.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
一个恶魔实体寄宿在你的灵魂中，产生灵魂碎片时可以感知其是否为诱人灵魂。

吞噬一个诱人灵魂会释放你的恶魔之魂，对目标周围10码范围内的所有敌人造成([353.236% of Spell Power])点暗影伤害。目标数量超过8个时造成的伤害降低。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
A demonic entity now inhabits your soul, allowing you to detect if a Soul Shard has a Succulent Soul when it's generated.

Consuming a Succulent Soul unleashes your demonic soul, dealing (353.236% of Spell Power) Shadow damage to all enemies within 10 yds of the target. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
痛苦
你的幽冥收割法术被体内的恶魔实体强化，使其在引导期间每秒获得1个灵魂碎片，每个碎片内含一个诱人灵魂。][召唤恶魔暴君]法术被体内的恶魔实体强化，使其获得3个灵魂碎片，每个碎片内含一个诱人灵魂。

 恶魔学识
你的法术被体内的恶魔实体强化，使其在引导期间每秒获得1个灵魂碎片，每个碎片内含一个诱人灵魂。][召唤恶魔暴君]法术被体内的恶魔实体强化，使其获得3个灵魂碎片，每个碎片内含一个诱人灵魂。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Affliction
Your Dark Harvest spell is empowered by the demonic entity within you, causing it to grant 1 Soul Shard that each contain a Succulent Soul every 1 sec while channeled.

 Demonology
Your Summon Demonic Tyrant spell is empowered by the demonic entity within you, causing it to grant 3 Soul Shards that each contain a Succulent Soul.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 收割战死者的残魂灌注于恶魔契印，将灵魂能量化为灵魂盛宴并大幅强化恶魔仆从。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Harvests lingering soul shards from foes, consuming them to empower sinister Succulent Souls and demonic pacts.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 当你消灭一个目标后，你有几率获得一个灵魂碎片，并且必定为诱人灵魂。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: When you kill a target, you have a chance to generate a Soul Shard that is guaranteed to be a Succulent Soul.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 黑暗契约的吸收量额外提高，数值相当于牺牲生命值的50%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Dark Pact now shields you for an additional 50% of the sacrificed health.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 腐蚀术的伤害提高30%，并且其周期性伤害会为你恢复所造成伤害的5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Corruption deals 30% increased damage and its periodic damage heals you for 5% of the damage dealt.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 鬼影缠身的伤害提高35%，施法时间缩短0.3秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases the damage of Haunt by 35% and reduces its cast time by 0.3 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 你的痛楚、腐蚀术和痛苦无常的爆击有几率触发夜幕。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Critical strikes from your Agony, Corruption, and Unstable Affliction have a chance to grant Nightfall.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 具现贪欲的持续时间延长5秒，并使灵魂横扫的伤害提高10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases the duration of Manifested Avarice by 5 sec and increases the damage of Soul Swipe by 10%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
使你的精通提高2%。

当有恶魔实体协助你作战时，此效果翻倍。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Increases your Mastery by 2%.

This effect is doubled while the demonic entity is aiding you in combat.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 每消耗一个诱人灵魂，你都有逐渐增高的几率释放你内心的恶魔之魂，使其攻击你的敌人，持续9秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Each Succulent Soul consumed has an increasing chance to unleash the Demonic Soul within you, enabling it to assault your enemies for 9 sec.

subSpellsCn.name: 灵魂横扫
subSpellsCn.description: 用恶毒之爪打击附近的敌人，对其目标造成([195.514% of Spell Power])点暗影伤害，并对10码范围内的其他敌人造成([130.346% of Spell Power])点暗影伤害。

subSpellsEn.name: Soul Swipe
subSpellsEn.description: Strikes nearby enemies with a malevolent claw, dealing (195.514% of Spell Power) Shadow damage to its target and (130.346% of Spell Power) Shadow damage to other enemies in 10 yds.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 痛楚的伤害提高10%，并且起始层数为3层。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Agony damage is increased by 10% and starts at 3 stacks.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
暗影箭和灾难之握造成的伤害提高10%，若目标受到鬼影缠身影响则提高20%。

幽冥收割造成的伤害提高10%，若目标受到鬼影缠身影响则提高20%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Shadow Bolt and Malefic Grasp damage increased by 10% or 20% if the target is affected by Haunt. 

Dark Harvest damage increased by 10% or 20% if the target is affected by Haunt.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
使吸取生命的伤害提高10%，生命虹吸现在会使腐蚀术的伤害额外提高10%。

幽冥收割的引导速度加快10%，造成的伤害提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Increases Drain Life damage by 10% and Siphon Life now increases the damage of Corruption by an additional 10%.

Dark Harvest channels 10% faster and deals 15% increased damage.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 腐蚀之种现在会以50%的效果向附近额外的2个敌人身上植入恶魔之种。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Seed of Corruption now embeds demon seeds into 2 additional nearby enemies at 50% effectiveness.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: [吸取灵魂 / 暗影箭]造成的伤害有 [吸取灵魂: 10 / 20]%的几率使你的下一个痛苦无常或腐蚀之种不消耗灵魂碎片，且变为瞬发。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Damage dealt by [Drain Soul / Shadow Bolt] has a [Drain Soul: 10 / 20]% chance to make your next Unstable Affliction or Seed of Corruption cost no Soul Shards and cast instantly.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 施放痛苦无常或腐蚀之种会使幽冥收割的冷却时间缩短1.5秒。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Casting Unstable Affliction or Seed of Corruption reduces the cooldown of Dark Harvest by 1.5 sec.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
吞噬每个受你伤害性持续效果影响的目标的生命力，在3秒内造成[([839.552% of Spell Power]) * (4)]点暗影烈焰伤害。

幽冥收割造成的伤害会为你恢复相当于伤害值50%的生命值。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Consume the life force of each target afflicted by your damaging periodic effects, dealing [(839.552% of Spell Power) * (4)] Shadowflame damage over 3 sec.

Damage dealt by Dark Harvest heals you for 50% of damage done.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 痛楚的伤害提高10%，并且痛楚现在会命中目标附近15码内的其他敌人。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases Agony damage by 10% and Agony now hits another nearby enemy within 15 yds of the target.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
使目标遭受痛苦，在8秒内造成([347.714% of Spell Power])点暗影伤害。多次使用该技能可以叠加。

如果此效果被驱散，对驱散者造成[([86.9285% of Spell Power]) * 6204 / 100]点伤害，并使其沉默4秒。目标身上每有一层此效果，伤害提高15%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Afflicts the target with (347.714% of Spell Power) Shadow damage over 8 sec. Multiple uses of this ability may overlap.

If dispelled, deals [(86.9285% of Spell Power) * 6204 / 100] damage to the dispeller and silences them for 4 sec. This damage is increased by 15% per stack on the target.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 痛楚和腐蚀术的伤害提高10%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases damage dealt by Agony and Corruption by 10%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 痛苦无常和腐蚀之种的伤害提高5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases damage dealt by Unstable Affliction and Seed of Corruption by 5%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 腐蚀之种的施法时间缩短0.20秒，其伤害提高5%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Reduces the cast time of Seed of Corruption by 0.20 sec and increases its damage by 5%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 精通提高2%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Mastery increased by 2%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 鬼影缠身造成的伤害有几率释放折磨其目标的恶魔灵魂。恶魔被释放后会发动毁灭性的攻击，然后被放逐回纳斯雷萨。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Damage dealt by Haunt has a chance to release the demonic soul haunting its target. When released, it unleashes a devastating attack before being banished back to Nathreza.

subSpellsCn.name: 纳斯雷萨之怒
subSpellsCn.description:
召唤一颗由纳斯雷萨废墟组成的流星，撞击时爆炸，对10码范围内的所有敌人造成([2274.09% of Spell Power])点暗影伤害。

目标数量超过8个后造成的伤害降低。

subSpellsEn.name: Wrath of Nathreza
subSpellsEn.description:
Calls down a meteor formed from the ruins of Nathreza that explodes upon impact, dealing (2274.09% of Spell Power) Shadow damage to all enemies within 10 yds.

Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn: 鬼影缠身的初始伤害提高50%，并且鬼影缠身对其宿主造成的伤害额外提高2%。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn: Increases the initial damage of Haunt by 50% and Haunt increases damage dealt to its host by an additional 2%.

selectedNodes.descriptionCn:
鬼影缠身现在会从扭曲虚空中召唤一个恶魔灵魂来折磨你的目标。

该灵魂不稳定且贪婪，在其持续时间内会对宿主和10码范围内3个受到你腐蚀术影响的目标造成[([45.2262% of Spell Power]) * 18]点暗影伤害。
selectedNodes.descriptionEn:
Haunt now calls upon a demonic soul from within the Twisting Nether to haunt your target.

The soul is unstable and ravenous, dealing [(45.2262% of Spell Power) * 18] Shadow damage to its host and 3 enemies within 10 yards suffering from your Corruption over its duration.
